headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng Attends BIS Governors' Meeting
headlines.summary_en: On November 8-9, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng attended the BIS Governors' Meeting in Basel, Switzerland. The attending central bank governors held in-depth exchanges on issues including the global economic and financial situation, FX market operations, central bank balance sheets and artificial intelligence. During the meeting, Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng also met with some participating central bank representatives to exchange views on issues of common concern and bilateral financial cooperation.

headlines.summary: 展望后市，西部证券首席策略分析师曹柳龙认为资本市场改革持续显效，大盘蓝筹股估值不高，中长期来看对A股市场不必悲观。曹柳龙表示，证券基金保险互换便利为机构提供流动性支持的可靠渠道，回购增持专项再贷款为上市公司与主要股东带来真金白银的资金来源，两项工具在市场承压期间有效阻断了负向螺旋、修复机构增持意愿；随着相关工具利率下调并转为长期性安排，市场的自我稳定能力有了制度依托。

headlines.title_en: Western Securities' Cao Liulong: No Need to Be Pessimistic About A-Shares in the Medium to Long Term
headlines.summary_en: Looking ahead, Cao Liulong, chief strategist at Western Securities, believes capital market reforms continue to show results and large-cap blue-chip valuations are not high, so there is no need to be pessimistic about the A-share market in the medium to long term. Cao said the securities-fund-insurance swap facility provides institutions with a reliable channel for liquidity support, while the special relending facility for buybacks and increases gives listed companies and major shareholders a source of real funds; the two tools effectively blocked negative spirals and restored institutions' willingness to increase holdings during market stress; as the rates on the relevant tools are cut and they become long-term arrangements, the market's self-stabilizing capacity has an institutional foundation.

headlines.title: 瑞银王宗豪：外资中国股票仓位总体不变，仍看好中国AI科技硬件
headlines.summary: 瑞银中国股票策略研究主管王宗豪指出，瑞银对约800只外资主动型基金的跟踪显示，三季度外资机构投资者的中国股票仓位总体保持不变。分行业看，国际投资者增持最多的是医疗保健、互联网和科技板块（可能来自IPO和配售），同时减持了保险、基础材料和汽车板块。鉴于风险回报具有吸引力，瑞银仍看好中国AI科技硬件，但近期全球科技股大跌可能对中国国内相关个股产生进一步连锁影响。鉴于AI的市场情绪仍较脆弱，且公募基金的AI科技硬件持仓仍处于高位，他建议采用科技硬件与银行相结合的杠铃策略。

headlines.title_en: UBS's Wang Zonghao: Foreign China Equity Positions Broadly Unchanged, Still Bullish on China AI Tech Hardware
headlines.summary_en: Wang Zonghao, head of China equity strategy research at UBS, noted that UBS's tracking of about 800 foreign active funds shows foreign institutional investors' China equity positions were broadly unchanged in Q3. By sector, international investors increased holdings the most in healthcare, internet and tech (possibly from IPOs and placements), while cutting insurance, basic materials and autos. Given attractive risk-reward, UBS remains bullish on China AI tech hardware, but the recent global tech selloff may have further knock-on effects on related Chinese domestic stocks. Given fragile AI market sentiment and still-high AI tech hardware holdings among mutual funds, he recommends a barbell strategy combining tech hardware and banks.

headlines.title_en: India Bans Exports of Lithium-Ion Battery Recycling Materials
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 11 - The Indian government announced on Tuesday an immediate ban on exports of lithium-ion battery black mass. Black mass is a battery recycling material containing metals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese. The Indian government changed the product's export status from "free export" to "prohibited export." The policy change bars Indian battery recycling companies from exporting lithium-ion battery black mass, aiming to encourage domestic processing of key battery materials in India and support India's strategic goal of developing an EV supply chain. According to a notice issued by India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry and its Department of Commerce, the export ban applies to lithium-ion battery black mass and related unclassified battery waste that does not contain lead, cadmium or mercury. India is one of the world's fastest-growing EV markets. headlines.title: 王毅同古巴党和政府特使、古共中央政治局委员、外交部长罗德里格斯会谈
headlines.summary: 11月11日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同古巴党和政府特使、古共中央政治局委员、外交部长罗德里格斯举行会谈。王毅说，在两国元首战略引领下，两党两国关系持续发展，传统友谊焕发新的生机活力。中方愿同古方共同落实好两国元首重要共识，不断巩固好、发展好中古友好关系，持续构建更加紧密的中古命运共同体。中方愿同古方加强多边领域沟通协作，继续在多边舞台上相互支持配合，共同反对强权政治和单边行径，推动全球南方的联合自强，构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Rodriguez, Special Envoy of the Communist Party of Cuba and the Cuban Government and Politburo Member and Foreign Minister
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with Rodriguez, special envoy of the Cuban Party and government, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of Cuba Central Committee and Foreign Minister. Wang Yi said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, relations between the two parties and two countries have continued to develop, and traditional friendship has gained new vitality. China is ready to work with Cuba to implement the important consensus of the two heads of state, continuously consolidate and develop China-Cuba friendly relations, and keep building a closer China-Cuba community with a shared future. China is ready to strengthen multilateral communication and coordination with Cuba, continue mutual support and cooperation on multilateral platforms, jointly oppose power politics and unilateral acts, promote the unity and self-strengthening of the Global South, and build a more just and reasonable global governance system. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 罗兵咸永道资本市场主管合伙人黄金钱：明年香港IPO市场好势头有望延续
headlines.summary: 近日，在第九届中国国际进口博览会期间，普华永道资本市场服务主管合伙人黄金钱表示，针对2026年以来香港跨境IPO市场的火热态势作出解读。他表示，本轮市场持续活跃并非单一市场情绪推动，而是产业周期、全球资本配置与香港上市制度持续优化三重因素叠加的结果，2027年香港IPO市场的向好势头有望得到延续。（界面）

headlines.title_en: PricewaterhouseCoopers Capital Markets Leader Huang Jinqian: Good Momentum in Hong Kong's IPO Market Expected to Continue Next Year
headlines.summary_en: Recently, during the ninth China International Import Expo, Huang Jinqian, PwC's lead partner for capital markets services, commented on the booming cross-border IPO market in Hong Kong since 2026. He said the market's continued activity is not driven by a single market sentiment but by the combination of three factors: the industry cycle, global capital allocation and continuous optimization of Hong Kong's listing regime, and the positive momentum in Hong Kong's IPO market is expected to continue in 2027. (Jiemian)

headlines.title: 中国注册会计师协会：完善招投标等选聘评价体系 坚决整治行业“内卷式”竞争
headlines.summary: 11月11日，中国注册会计师协会党委书记、秘书长江湧在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期，中国注册会计师协会将紧紧围绕服务国家建设主题和诚信建设主线，着力推进行业规范化。协会将聚焦优化行业发展环境，协调推动企业进一步完善招投标等选聘评价体系，形成以质量为导向的会计事务所选聘机制，坚决整治行业“内卷式”竞争。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants: Improve Tendering and Selection Evaluation Systems, Resolutely Curb 'Involution-Style' Competition in the Industry
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, Jiang Yong, Party Committee Secretary and Secretary-General of the Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants (CICPA), said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the CICPA will closely focus on the theme of serving national development and the main line of integrity building, and strive to advance the standardization of the industry. The association will focus on optimizing the industry development environment, coordinate and promote enterprises to further improve selection and evaluation systems such as bidding, form a quality-oriented selection mechanism for accounting firms, and resolutely rectify "involution-style" competition in the industry.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai fully adjusts on-street parking charges: no charge for the first 15 minutes, with limits on the number of times
headlines.summary_en: On November 11, the Shanghai Municipal Development and Reform Commission, the Municipal Transport Commission and the Municipal Finance Bureau jointly issued the Notice on Optimizing the City's Road Parking Charging Policy, which will officially take effect on November 18, 2026. It is the first comprehensive adjustment to road parking charges since Shanghai issued its implementation opinions on motor vehicle management in 2005. The new rules specify that a single motor vehicle may be exempt from parking fees for a limited number of single stays of 15 minutes or less at road parking lots, capped at 2 times per day on weekdays and 3 times per day on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays; charges for stays exceeding 15 minutes start from the entry time, and the short-term free parking does not apply to temporary road parking lots charged per session. headlines.title: 财政部：全链条依法重拳惩治财务报表和审计违法违规行为
headlines.summary: 财政部会计司司长林启云在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将更加注重法治与监督，财会监督体系是重要抓手。一方面把尺子打准，系统推进会计准则等标准，加快完善注册会计师行业配套制度；另一方面把规矩守严，建设协同高效的会计监督体系，全链条依法重拳惩治财务报表和审计违法违规行为，维护市场经济秩序。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: Rigorously punish financial statement and audit violations in accordance with the law across the entire chain
headlines.summary_en: Lin Qiyun, Director of the Accounting Department of the Ministry of Finance, said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, greater emphasis will be placed on the rule of law and supervision, with the accounting supervision system as an important lever. On the one hand, the yardstick will be made more accurate by systematically advancing standards such as accounting standards and accelerating the improvement of supporting systems for the certified public accountant industry; on the other hand, the rules will be strictly enforced by building a coordinated and efficient accounting supervision system and punishing illegal and non-compliant acts in financial statements and auditing across the entire chain in accordance with the law, so as to safeguard the order of the market economy.

headlines.title_en: A-Share Close: ChiNext Index Opens Higher and Rises Over 3%; 'Yi Zhong Tian' All Surge More Than 13%
headlines.summary_en: The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with ChiNext up more than 3% in the afternoon. Computing power hardware stocks rebounded sharply, with Yuanjie Technology, Dongshan Precision, Accelink Technologies, Cambridge Technology and others hitting limit up, while Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC Optical all rose more than 13%. The AI comic-drama concept remained active, with Shanghai Film hitting limit up to a new high and Wentou Holdings and Kaiser Culture also sealing limit up. Robotics concept stocks stayed strong, with Fulai New Materials up for a second straight session to a new high, and more than ten stocks including Xiangyang Bearing, Fenglong and Ruide Zhiqu hitting limit up. On the downside, the solar sector surged then pulled back, with Maxwell down nearly 10%. Gainers outnumbered decliners, with more than 3,500 stocks up across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover near RMB 1.69 trillion today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite was up 0.46%, Shenzhen Component up 1.32% and ChiNext up 3.11%.
